newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shr index plunges 2.83 pct,breaks support.
newsitem.headline: Manila shr index plunges 2.83 pct,breaks support.

text.p: The Philippine stock market main index slumped 69.30 points, or 2.83 percent, at 2,379.63 points in early Monday trade reacting to the Dow's fall and concerns over the peso's drop, traders said.

"It's the Dow that's causing this plus there's no positive news coming from our front. There's also the concern about the peso," said Jose Ricardo Garcia, executive vice-president at Diversified Securities.
The market barometer breached the 2,400 support and barely an hour after the session started, it shed 86.50 points, or 3.53 percent, at 2,362.43.
Losers trounced gainers 99 to 4 with 23 issues unchanged.

"Much of the decline was caused by the non-presence of buyers. They are pulling out, looking at prices to see if they've reached bottom before coming in," said Juanis Barredo, technical analyst at Citisecurities Inc.
The next support level is seen at 2,200 points.
PLDT, the most actively traded issue, fell further by 30 pesos to 845 pesos in midsession.
Other active losers include firstliners Ayala Land Inc and Manila Electric Corp B including San Miguel Corp B.
